title: AI Research in 30 Seconds: Claim, Source, Confidence
description: AI can help you research faster, but you still need to verify the answer. Use three columns: the exact claim, the original source that supports it, and a confidence label: verified, partly supported, or unverified. Check source context and dates, trace back to primary evidence, and run a small reproducible test for numbers or code. This Professor Mia explainer is educational; any simulated interface is illustrative, not proof of a live research operation. Save the checklist and comment SOURCE with the research workflow you want explained next.
pinned_comment: Which source check catches the most AI mistakes for you: claim, date, context, or reproducibility?
